SELECT SUM (o.sales_qty) AS salesQty, count(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orderCount,
round(SUM (o.sales_amount_currency_rate),2) AS sales, round(SUM (o.sales_amount_currency_rate) / ( count(DISTINCT o.order_id) ),2) AS perCustomerTransaction,
round(SUM (o.sales_amount_cny_settle_rate),2) AS sales, round(SUM (o.sales_amount_cny_settle_rate) / ( count(DISTINCT o.order_id) ),2) AS perCustomerTransaction,
round(SUM (o.sales_amount),2) AS sales, round(SUM (o.sales_amount) / ( count(DISTINCT o.order_id) ),2) AS perCustomerTransaction,
o.sku_no AS skuNo, min(o.product_name) AS productName
FROM dmp_order_delivery_report AS o
FROM dmp_order_create_report AS o
AND o.is_combo = 1
AND o.is_combo != 1
GROUP BY o.sku_no ORDER BY
${item.field} ${item.sort}
sales DESC
